correctness.rationale: All factorization diagrams are indexed by outer-image lengths s,t and inner words of common weighted length n. An inductive Fibonacci bound for short s,t and a subexponential weighted-composition bound for long outer images yield the two-part upper bound. If both inner words are pure, their distinctness and nonautomorphism force a proper divisor of n, giving the arithmetic parity threshold. The injective (a,bb) construction supplies \(\varphi^2\), and the even-length (u,v),(aa,b) construction supplies \(2^{3/2}\). Direct independent exhaustive enumeration at \(n=2,\ldots,8\) verifies the factorization count and lower constructions; it is not the asymptotic proof.

value.rationale: Provides a sharp global asymptotic count for a natural uniform random model of free-semigroup endomorphisms and distinguishes two genuinely different exponential mechanisms—weighted Fibonacci compositions versus arithmetic divisors. Generic irreducibility follows quantitatively and the parity split is not a mere reparameterization or finite sample. The exact leading constants and larger-alphabet cases remain open.
